value.rationale: Kneser disjointness graphs are a canonical Johnson-scheme family; exact temporal orbit counts of the natural reversible adjacency wave are motivated dynamical invariants. The result identifies a genuine modular structural transition: only n≡1 has nonzero stationary states, while n≡2 has a size-four temporal Jordan sector and sharp period 36, with exact positive-density proportion (1-q^-2)(1-q^{-(n-1)}). This is an infinite-family classification with quantitative orbit populations, not an isolated small case or mere recurrence substitution.
